answer: Counterparty diversity: each agent carries a pigment code from its sponsor; rewards climb a terrace — 4 pigments pay 25%, 8 pay 60%, 12 pay 120 credits. A sybil ring's 100 fakes share one sponsor, so they carry one pigment, count as one, and never clear step one. Faking it needs 12 credentials at 40 each plus a 40-credit bond per fake — 100 fakes burn 4,480 — while one honest agent pays 40 once, keeps its income in a haven fakes can't copy into.
